role: CI gate: counts `.font(.system(size: <numeric literal>))` in the app target and in the watch target and fails above .ci/fixed_font_budget.txt (13) / .ci/fixed_font_watch_budget.txt (0).
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd. BUDGET_FILE env or .ci/fixed_font_budget.txt; missing -> 66; non-integer -> 65. SOURCE_ROOT=$1 or Emuqu; WATCH_ROOT=$2 or 'EmuquWatch Watch App'. count=measure(app), watch_count=measure(watch). Watch budget missing -> 66, non-integer -> 65. Fails if either exceeds; prints below-budget hints; on success appends app count (not watch) to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY. Wired: gates.yml, ci.yml, Makefile.

flags.text: No cd to repo root and os.walk on a missing directory yields nothing. Run from any other directory, both counts are 0 and the gate passes (the budget-file check fails first only if .ci/ is also missing relative to cwd).

units.does: Runs embedded Python over root $1: walks *.swift files, skips lines starting with //, and counts `.font(.system(size: X` occurrences whose first argument is a numeric literal; prints the count.

flags.text: Only the `.font(.system(size:` spelling is counted; `Font.system(size: 14)` passed through a variable or `.font(Font.system(size:))` is not.
